evidence_items.locator: Chapter 2 highlights, item 2: Open-weight models catch up
evidence_items.explanation: The report contrasts a January 2024 open-versus-closed Chatbot Arena score gap of 8.04% with 1.70% in February 2025. This supports capability convergence, but its baseline is not April 20 and its measure does not establish diminished pricing power or switching barriers.

Epoch reports an average capability gap while explaining that it sometimes closes entirely. This is material caution against treating one convergence episode as permanent disappearance of differentiation; it does not itself measure commercial moats.

unresolved_gaps: No verified longitudinal measure connects the April 2024 baseline to sustained changes in pricing power or switching barriers across the named suppliers.
The capability evidence does not establish the broader commercial early-resolution rule.
